now.title: Daredevil S1
now.text: In episode 6, Vladimir blames Daredevil for his brother's death, then learns Fisk was the killer.

proposed.text: In episode 5, Vladimir blames Daredevil for his brother's death, then learns Fisk was the killer.

changes.evidence: Vladimir learns from Turk Barrett that Fisk killed Anatoly in episode 5, 'World on Fire' (Fisk pays Turk to reveal it; Vladimir prepares for war and is surrounded by police at the end of that episode). Episode 6 is his death, already its own record.

now.title: Daredevil S1
now.text: In episode 9, Hoffman kills his partner Blake on Fisk's orders, then flees for his life.

proposed.text: In episode 8, Hoffman poisons his partner Blake in hospital on Fisk's orders, then blames the masked man for his death.

changes.evidence: Hoffman injects Blake with poison in hospital in episode 8, 'Shadows in the Glass', is knocked out by the masked man, and afterwards claims the masked man killed Blake. Hoffman does not appear in episode 9 (only mentioned); his going into hiding under Owlsley is shown only in episode 13, which the next record covers.

now.title: Daredevil S3
now.text: In episode 2, Inmate Jasper Evans stabs Fisk on Fisk's own orders, getting him moved out of prison.

changes.evidence: Evans is a Rikers Island inmate serving time for two 1991 murders. After he stabs Fisk in episode 2 he is put in solitary confinement. He is only taken out of prison later, to the Bulletin, in episode 6. 'At large' is wrong for where episode 2 leaves him.
